body: A burst of fire. Creatures in the area take fire damage. A successful Reflex save halves that damage.
Before you attack, you may take a penalty on melee attack rolls to gain a bonus on melee damage rolls. The trade depends on your base attack bonus.
A wizard bonds with an object or a familiar. Once per day, a bonded object lets the wizard cast a known spell they did not prepare.
The summoner grants their eidolon a temporary evolution.
A transmuter chooses Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution and gains an enhancement bonus to that score. The choice can be changed when spells are prepared, and the bonus grows with wizard level.
A transmuter can make a short-range touch attack that deals bludgeoning damage. Uses per day depend on Intelligence.
You use Dexterity instead of Strength on combat maneuver checks.
The chance that your armor ruins an arcane spell drops further.
As a swift action, you lower the chance that the armor you wear ruins an arcane spell.
As a swift action, you charge your weapons with arcane energy so they deal extra damage until your next turn.
You are proficient with heavy armor.
You are proficient with light armor.
You are proficient with medium armor.
A critical hit also causes the target to bleed.
In melee, concealment is less likely to spoil your attack, and an unseen attacker gains less against you.
A critical hit can blind the target. A successful Fortitude save avoids it.
You take no penalty for an improvised melee weapon, and an unarmed foe is flat-footed against those attacks.
Before a melee attack, you may spend one use of channel energy to add that damage to the attack. A successful Will save halves the added damage.
When a melee attack hits, you can strike a foe adjacent to the first. Your Armor Class takes a penalty until your next turn.
You may take a penalty on melee attacks to gain a dodge bonus to Armor Class. The trade depends on your base attack bonus.
You can make additional attacks of opportunity equal to your Dexterity modifier, including while flat-footed.
You gain a bonus on the attack roll to confirm a critical hit.
When you confirm a critical hit, you can apply the effects of two critical feats.
While wielding a weapon you have focused on, you can demoralize every foe that can see you.
Before you attack, you may take a penalty on ranged attack rolls to gain a bonus on ranged damage rolls. The trade depends on your base attack bonus.
Against a stunned or flat-footed foe, one hit with a weapon you have greater focus in deals extra damage and causes Constitution bleed.
A critical hit can deafen the target. A successful Fortitude save avoids it.
Your Combat Maneuver Defense uses your Hit Dice instead of your base attack bonus.
Once each round, you can knock aside one ranged attack that would hit you.
Enemies you threaten have a harder time casting a spell defensively.
You gain a dodge bonus to Armor Class.
Your off-hand weapon adds your full Strength bonus to damage.
A critical hit can exhaust the target. A successful Fortitude save leaves the target fatigued instead.
You are proficient with one exotic weapon.
You take a smaller penalty for each range increment.
An unarmed strike against a foe slowed by your style can stagger that foe. A successful Fortitude save avoids the stagger.
As long as each melee attack hits, you can keep striking a foe adjacent to the last. Your Armor Class takes a penalty until your next turn.
You are better at a bull rush, and a foe you push provokes attacks from your allies.
You are better at disarming a foe, and you choose where the weapon lands.
A successful feint denies the foe their Dexterity bonus to Armor Class until your next turn.
You are better at grappling, and maintaining a grapple is a move action.
You are better at an overrun, and a foe you overrun provokes attacks from your allies.
Your piercing attacks ignore more of an object's hardness.
The shield bonus to your Armor Class increases further.
You are better at sundering, and damage past what it takes to break the item hits its wielder.
You are better at a trip, and a foe you trip provokes attacks from your allies.
You gain a third attack with your off-hand weapon.
When you take the attack action, one attack rolls four times as many weapon damage dice.
You gain a further bonus on attack rolls with a weapon you have focused on.
You gain a further bonus on damage rolls with a weapon you have specialized in.
You do not provoke an attack when you bull rush, and you are better at the attempt.
The threat range of one chosen weapon doubles.
You do not provoke an attack when you disarm, and you are better at the attempt.
You can feint as a move action.
You do not provoke an attack when you grapple, and you are better at the attempt.
You do not provoke an attack when you overrun, the foe cannot step aside, and you are better at the attempt.
Your ranged attacks ignore partial cover and partial concealment.
You can bash with a shield and still keep its bonus to Armor Class.
You do not provoke an attack when you sunder, and you are better at the attempt.
You do not provoke an attack when you trip, and you are better at the attempt.
You gain a second attack with your off-hand weapon.
Your unarmed strikes count as armed attacks, and you choose whether they deal lethal or nonlethal damage.
When you take the attack action, one attack rolls three times as many weapon damage dice.
You take no penalty for an improvised weapon, and it deals damage one step higher.
You add your Strength modifier to Intimidate checks.
While you are using Wind Stance, moving grants greater concealment against ranged attacks.
You can extend your reach by 5 feet until the end of your turn. Your Armor Class takes a penalty until your next turn.
As a standard action, you can fire two arrows at one foe with a single attack roll.
You are proficient with one martial weapon.
During a full attack, you can make two extra unarmed strikes against a foe that cannot defend itself fully.
You gain a dodge bonus to Armor Class against attacks of opportunity provoked by moving.
The penalty for shooting while your mount takes a double move or runs is halved.
Once each round, a Ride check can negate a hit against your mount.
Your piercing attacks ignore some of an object's hardness.
As a standard action, one ranged attack ignores the target's armor bonuses. You lose your Dexterity bonus to Armor Class until your next turn.
You take no penalty for shooting or throwing into melee.
You can draw a weapon as a free action.
Reloading one chosen crossbow takes less time.
During a full attack, you can fire one extra ranged attack. Every attack that round takes a penalty.
While mounted, you can attack in the middle of a charge and keep moving.
An unarmed strike can slow the foe until your next turn. A successful Fortitude save avoids the slow.
A shaken foe you hit is flat-footed against your attacks until your next turn.
The shield bonus to your Armor Class increases.
A shield bash takes no two-weapon penalty, and the shield's enhancement bonus applies to the bash.
You are proficient with shields other than tower shields.
A shield bash also pushes the foe back.
You can move, fire one ranged attack, and keep moving.
A critical hit can sicken the target. A successful Fortitude save avoids it.
You are proficient with simple weapons.
When you deflect a ranged weapon, you can catch it instead.
A foe you threaten who fails to cast defensively provokes an attack from you.
A mounted charge deals extra damage.
You can move both before and after a melee attack.
A critical hit can stagger the target. A successful Fortitude save avoids it.
When a foe tries to move away, your attack of opportunity can stop that movement.
When an adjacent foe takes a 5-foot step, you can step with them.
You can strike a foe that attacks you in melee even when that foe's reach is longer than yours.
A critical hit can stun the target. A successful Fortitude save leaves the target staggered instead.
You can declare an unarmed strike a stunning attack. A successful Fortitude save avoids the stun. The number of uses each day equals your level.
You take no penalty for throwing an improvised weapon.
A critical hit can fatigue the target. A successful Fortitude save avoids it.
You are proficient with tower shields.
A mounted overrun knocks the foe down, and your mount can attack that foe.
While fighting with two weapons, you gain a shield bonus to Armor Class.
The penalties for fighting with two weapons are smaller.
When both weapons hit, you deal extra damage.
A mounted charge with a lance can also push the foe back.
When you take the attack action, one attack rolls twice as many weapon damage dice.
You use Dexterity instead of Strength on attack rolls with light melee weapons.
You gain a bonus on damage rolls with a weapon you have focused on.
As a full-round action, you make one melee attack against every foe you can reach.
If you move more than 5 feet, you gain concealment against ranged attacks until your next turn.
You gain a bonus on Acrobatics and Fly checks.
Each time you move, you can treat 5 feet of difficult terrain as normal terrain. That includes a 5-foot step.
You gain a bonus on Perception and Sense Motive checks.
You can channel energy to heal or harm outsiders of one chosen alignment.
You gain a bonus on Handle Animal and Ride checks.
You gain a bonus on Climb and Swim checks.
Creatures you summon gain extra Strength and Constitution.
You have an easier time casting a spell while threatened.
You can spend a use of channel energy to take control of nearby undead. A successful Will save resists it.
You gain a bonus on Bluff and Disguise checks.
You gain a bonus on Disable Device and Sleight of Hand checks.
You stay conscious below 0 hit points and can still take a standard action. You stabilize on your own.
You can channel energy to heal or harm elementals of one chosen type.
You are better at enduring forced marches, hunger, harsh weather, and holding your breath.
You can channel energy two more times each day.
Your ki pool holds two more points.
You can use lay on hands two more times each day.
Your lay on hands also removes one additional mercy condition you know.
You can use bardic performance for six more rounds each day.
You can rage for six more rounds each day.
Your base speed increases by 5 feet when you carry no more than a light load and wear no heavier than light armor.
You gain a bonus on Fortitude saves.
Spells from your chosen school gain a further increase to their save DC.
You gain a further bonus on caster level checks to overcome spell resistance.
Your channel energy ability is harder to resist, raising its save DC.
You can counter a spell with any spell of the same school that is of an equal or higher level.
You can choose your familiar from a wider list of more powerful creatures.
Once per day you can reroll a Fortitude save, and you must take the second result.
Once per day you can reroll a Will save, and you must take the second result.
Once per day you can reroll a Reflex save, and you must take the second result.
You gain a bonus on Will saves.
You attract a loyal cohort and a number of followers, set by your leadership score.
You gain a bonus on Reflex saves.
You gain a bonus on Spellcraft and Use Magic Device checks.
Your skill with one Craft or Profession lets you qualify for item creation feats and craft magic items.
You can cast spells while in a wild shape form.
You can move through a small amount of difficult terrain each round as if it were normal.
You gain a bonus on Diplomacy and Intimidate checks.
You run faster, keep your Dexterity bonus to AC while running, and jump farther with a running start.
You can exclude creatures from the area when you channel energy.
You gain a bonus on Heal and Survival checks.
You gain a bonus on checks with one chosen skill, and a larger bonus at higher ranks.
You can prepare a number of chosen spells without consulting your spellbook.
You gain a bonus on caster level checks to overcome spell resistance.
You gain a bonus on Escape Artist and Stealth checks.
You gain extra hit points, and more as your level rises.
You can channel energy to make undead in the area flee instead of taking damage.
You can create potions that reproduce a spell you know of third level or lower.
You can create magic rods.
You can create magic staves.
You can create wands holding a spell of fourth level or lower.
You can create magic rings.
A spell's variable numeric effects increase by half, and it uses a slot one level higher.
A spell's range doubles, and it uses a slot one level higher.
A spell's duration doubles, and it uses a slot one level higher.
A spell's variable numeric effects are at maximum, and it uses a slot three levels higher.
You can cast a spell as a swift action, and it uses a slot four levels higher.
You can cast a spell without its verbal component, and it uses a slot one level higher.
You can cast a spell without its somatic component, and it uses a slot one level higher.
A spell's area increases by half, and it uses a slot three levels higher.
You gain a bonus on initiative checks.
You can create scrolls holding a spell you know.
Spells from one chosen school gain an increase to their save DC.
You gain a bonus on attack rolls with one chosen weapon.
You can cast spells without their inexpensive material components.
You can cast a spell at a higher effective level, raising its save DC, using a slot of that level.
You can create wondrous items.
You can create magic weapons, armor, and shields, and you can mend the ones that are damaged.
You can create constructs.
You gain a bonus on attack and damage rolls with ranged weapons at close range.
A ranged touch attack deals a small amount of acid damage.
You inscribe a personal rune, visible or invisible, on a creature or object.
A stabilized dying creature begins to lose hit points again.
You create drinkable water, scaling with your caster level.
You create several dim, moving lights that last a short time.
One humanoid of low level loses its next action unless it saves.
You sense magical auras nearby and can study them to learn school and strength.
You determine whether a creature, object, or area is poisoned or poisonous.
A ranged touch attack deals a small amount of damage to one undead creature.
One creature is dazzled briefly unless it saves.
You create illusory sound, with volume scaling by caster level.
One creature gains a small bonus on a single attack, save, or skill check.
You instantly learn which way is north.
An object glows like a torch for a duration based on caster level.
Creatures in the area take a penalty on Perception checks and saves against sleep.
You move a small unattended object a short distance by concentrating.
You repair minor damage to one object.
You hold whispered conversation at a distance with creatures you point at.
You open or close a small or light unlocked object at range.
You perform minor tricks: soil or clean an item, chill or warm food, colour or tidy things.
You make spoiled food and water safe to consume.
A ranged touch attack deals a small amount of cold damage.
You can read scrolls and magical writing you could not otherwise understand.
One creature gains a small bonus on saving throws for a short time.
A dying creature is stabilized and stops losing hit points.
A musical instrument of your choice appears for the duration.
Your touch attack makes one creature fatigued unless it saves.
One creature gains a single temporary hit point.
You ward an area and are alerted, mentally or by sound, when a creature enters it.
You send a Tiny animal to a destination you designate, carrying a small note or object.
You command a rope to coil, knot, or tie itself as you direct.
Enemies in the area take a penalty on attack rolls and saves against fear.
Allies in the area gain a small bonus on attack rolls and saves against fear.
You make a flask of water into holy water.
One weapon strikes true against evil foes and counts as good-aligned for damage reduction.
A cone of flame damages creatures in front of you, with a save for half.
You calm several animals so they do not act unless provoked.
One creature becomes frightened, or shaken if it saves.
One animal regards you as a trusted friend.
One humanoid regards you as a trusted friend.
Your touch deals negative energy damage and may cause a temporary Strength penalty.
A burst of colour stuns, blinds, or knocks out nearby creatures by their level.
One creature obeys a single-word command for one round unless it saves.
You understand all spoken and written languages you encounter.
Your touch heals a modest amount of damage, scaling with caster level.
You make a flask of water into unholy water.
You see how near death the creatures around you are.
One creature is immune to poison's ongoing effects for hours.
You sense a specific kind of animal or plant within range.
You sense chaotic auras, learning strength and location.
You sense evil auras, learning strength and location.
You sense good auras, learning strength and location.
You sense lawful auras, learning strength and location.
You sense hidden doors and compartments in the area.
You sense simple traps, pits, and deadfalls nearby.
You sense undead auras, learning strength and location.
You alter your appearance, though the illusion does not change how you feel to the touch.
You gain a bonus on attack and damage rolls, scaling with caster level.
One creature becomes shaken unless it saves.
One creature is unharmed by hot or cold environments within a wide band.
One humanoid grows a size category, gaining Strength and losing Dexterity.
Plants in the area grab and hold creatures, hampering movement.
Ranged attacks against you have a chance to miss outright.
You remove writing, mundane or magical, from one object.
Your base speed increases substantially for a short time.
Outlined creatures and objects glow, denying them concealment from invisibility.
Falling creatures or objects drift down slowly and take no damage.
A disk of force follows you and carries a load for you.
Fresh berries become nourishing and cure a small amount of damage each.
A slippery coating covers an object or the ground, risking dropped items and falls.
Animals cannot perceive the warded creatures.
Undead cannot perceive the warded creatures.
One door, gate, or window is held shut as if locked.
Nearby creatures become fascinated and more receptive to your suggestions.
You learn the properties of one magic item or study auras in detail.
Your touch deals negative energy damage, or heals an undead creature.
One creature gains a bonus on Acrobatics checks made to jump.
One creature behaves randomly for one round.
You remove magical ability damage, or one point of temporary penalty.
Your base speed increases for hours.
An invisible force grants an armor bonus that stacks with your Dexterity.
You mask or fake one object's magical aura against detection.
One natural weapon of an animal or creature gains an enhancement bonus.
Darts of force strike unerringly, adding a dart at higher caster levels.
Up to three stones become magical sling or thrown ammunition.
One weapon gains an enhancement bonus on attack and damage.
A riding horse appears, saddled and bridled, for hours.
A bank of fog grants concealment to creatures within it.
Your party leaves no tracks or scent behind.
Flame in your palm can be thrown as a ranged touch attack or used in melee.

One creature gains bonuses against evil foes and resists mental control.
One creature gains bonuses against good foes and resists mental control.
One creature gains bonuses against lawful foes and resists mental control.
A ray saps one creature's Strength for a time.
One humanoid shrinks a size category, gaining Dexterity and losing Strength.
Allies gain a bonus against fear, and an existing fear effect is suppressed.
Creatures must save to attack the warded creature at all.
An invisible shield grants a shield bonus to AC and blocks magic missile.
One creature gains a deflection bonus to AC, scaling with caster level.
Your club or quarterstaff strikes as a larger weapon and gains a bonus.
Your touch deals electricity damage, with a bonus to hit metal-armored targets.
You create a silent illusion of your design that you can move by concentrating.

You can converse with animals for a short time.

You suppress strong emotions in the area, ending rage and fear effects.
One creature gains a bonus to Dexterity for minutes.
